definitions: The lower extremity of the leg, below the ankle, on which a person or animal stands or walks.
A unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).
The lowest part or base of something.
The part of a sock or stocking that covers the foot.
A group of syllables in verse treated as a single metrical unit.
examples: At the foot of the mountain.
The poem has an iambic foot.
